mapper.select: SELECT social_account.id, social_account.type, social_account.app_id, social_account.app_secret, social_account.create_time, social_account.update_time, social_account.del_flag, social_account.create_by, social_account.update_by, social_account.tenant_id FROM social_account AS social_account WHERE social_account.app_id = #{appId} AND social_account.del_flag = '0'

SELECT sa.id, sa.type, sa.app_id, sa.app_secret, sa.create_time, sa.update_time, sa.del_flag, sa.create_by, sa.update_by, sa.tenant_id FROM social_account AS sa WHERE sa.app_id = #{appId} AND sa.type = 'WX_MA' AND sa.del_flag = '0'

SELECT social_account.id, social_account.type, social_account.app_id, social_account.app_secret, social_account.create_time, social_account.update_time, social_account.del_flag, social_account.create_by, social_account.update_by, social_account.tenant_id FROM social_account AS social_account WHERE social_account.id = #{id} AND social_account.del_flag = '0'
